intro: The Greek Chicken Pita is a signature item on the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas), bringing together Mediterranean flavors in a convenient handheld format. This expertly crafted pita features tender grilled chicken, cool tzatziki, fresh vegetables, and tangy feta cheese wrapped in warm pita bread. With 720 calories and 48g of protein, it delivers satisfying nutrition and authentic taste that has made it a customer favorite across CAVA locations nationwide.
priceCalories: Priced between $12.95 and $13.45 depending on location, the Greek Chicken Pita offers excellent value for a complete meal. At 720 calories, it provides a balanced nutritional profile with 48g of protein, 64g of carbohydrates, and 30g of fat. This calorie count makes it a moderate option on the [full CAVA menu](/), suitable for lunch or dinner while keeping your daily nutritional goals on track without feeling overly heavy.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets the Greek Chicken Pita apart is its perfect balance of Mediterranean ingredients working in harmony. The creamy tzatziki sauce complements the seasoned grilled chicken, while fresh tomato and cucumber add crisp texture. Crumbled feta cheese provides tangy richness, and shredded romaine adds a refreshing crunch. Each component is thoughtfully selected to create an authentic Greek-inspired flavor experience that distinguishes it from typical fast-casual options.
nutritionFacts: With 720 calories per serving, the Greek Chicken Pita delivers substantial nutrition in a single meal. The impressive 48g of protein supports muscle maintenance and keeps you satisfied for hours. The 64g of carbohydrates provide energy from the pita bread and vegetables, while 30g of fat comes primarily from heart-healthy sources like olive oil in the tzatziki and feta cheese, making it a well-rounded choice.
whatsInside: This curated pita features six key ingredients working together perfectly. Warm pita bread serves as the foundation, while marinated grilled chicken from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) provides the protein base. Cool, creamy tzatziki sauce adds Mediterranean flavor, complemented by fresh-cut tomato and cucumber. Tangy crumbled feta cheese and crisp shredded romaine complete this thoughtfully composed handheld meal that captures authentic Greek flavors.
tasteLike: The Greek Chicken Pita delivers a harmonious blend of cool and savory Mediterranean flavors. Each bite combines tender, herb-marinated chicken with refreshing tzatziki that adds garlic and cucumber notes. The fresh vegetables provide crisp texture and brightness, while salty feta cheese adds bold tanginess. The warm pita bread ties everything together with its soft, slightly chewy texture, creating a satisfying taste experience reminiscent of authentic Greek street food.

The fresh vegetables provide crisp texture and brightness, while salty feta cheese adds bold tanginess. customize: While the Greek Chicken Pita comes perfectly balanced as designed, CAVA allows customization to match your preferences. You can request extra tzatziki for more creaminess, add additional vegetables from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings), or include a side of hummus for dipping. Consider adding extra feta for bolder flavor, requesting light sauce for fewer calories, or pairing with sides from the menu to create your ideal Mediterranean meal experience.
pairsWell: The Greek Chicken Pita pairs excellently with lighter sides that complement its Mediterranean flavors. Consider adding a side of warm pita chips with hummus from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) for extra satisfaction. A refreshing drink from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) balances the savory flavors perfectly. For a complete meal, pair with a fresh side salad or seasonal soup to round out your dining experience without overwhelming your palate.
healthyChoice: The Greek Chicken Pita represents a balanced choice with impressive nutritional credentials. Its 48g of protein makes it excellent for those prioritizing muscle maintenance and satiety. The fresh vegetables provide essential vitamins and fiber, while the moderate 720 calories fit well into most dietary plans. The inclusion of probiotic-rich tzatziki and nutrient-dense ingredients makes this a smarter fast-casual option compared to heavily processed alternatives found elsewhere.
howToOrder: Ordering the Greek Chicken Pita is straightforward at any CAVA location. Simply select it from the Curated Pitas section of the menu, and it will be prepared with all standard ingredients included. You can request modifications at the counter or through the CAVA app for pickup. For those with dietary restrictions, check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) beforehand to ensure it meets your needs and discuss any substitutions with staff.
vsAlternatives: Compared to other options on the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas), the Greek Chicken Pita offers moderate calories at 720 versus the Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita at 930 calories. It provides more protein than the Crispy Falafel Pita while being lighter than the Steak + Feta Pita at 820 calories. Its balanced nutrition and authentic Mediterranean flavors make it ideal for those seeking traditional Greek taste without excessive calories.
whoShouldTry: The Greek Chicken Pita is perfect for Mediterranean food enthusiasts seeking authentic flavors in a convenient format. Fitness-conscious diners will appreciate its high 48g protein content, while busy professionals will love its satisfying yet balanced 720 calories. First-time CAVA visitors should try this signature item to experience the restaurant's quality and flavor philosophy. Anyone avoiding heavy, greasy fast food will find this a refreshing, wholesome alternative.
worthTrying: The Greek Chicken Pita absolutely deserves a spot on your must-try list at CAVA. Its combination of quality ingredients, balanced nutrition, and authentic Mediterranean flavors justifies the $12.95-$13.45 price point. The generous protein content keeps you satisfied for hours, while fresh ingredients ensure you are getting real food value. Whether you are a regular customer or first-time visitor, this curated pita exemplifies why CAVA has earned its reputation for elevated fast-casual dining.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Greek Chicken Pita?
faqs.a: The Greek Chicken Pita contains 720 calories per serving, with 48g of protein, 64g of carbohydrates, and 30g of fat. This makes it a moderate-calorie option suitable for most meal plans while providing substantial nutrition and satisfaction.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in the Greek Chicken Pita?
faqs.a: The Greek Chicken Pita includes pita bread, grilled chicken, tzatziki sauce, tomato and cucumber, crumbled feta cheese, and shredded romaine lettuce. All ingredients are prepared fresh and combine to create authentic Mediterranean flavors in every bite.

faqs.q: How much does the Greek Chicken Pita cost?
faqs.a: The Greek Chicken Pita is priced between $12.95 and $13.45, with the exact price varying by location. This price includes all standard ingredients and represents good value for a complete, protein-rich meal at CAVA.

faqs.q: Is the Greek Chicken Pita gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, the Greek Chicken Pita is not gluten-free because it contains pita bread made with wheat. However, you can explore gluten-free options on the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) or create a custom bowl with similar ingredients using a gluten-free base instead.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Greek Chicken Pita?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the Greek Chicken Pita by requesting modifications like extra tzatziki, additional vegetables, or light sauce. While it comes perfectly balanced as designed, CAVA accommodates preferences to help you create your ideal meal experience.
